description: Timer — runs an artifact's operation on a schedule (every N minutes, daily at a time, or once). It acts on a key its owner issues when they arm it, over the timer's workspace, and stops when the key is revoked or the timer is disarmed. Lumen fires it.

timer.description: schedule (one of every_minutes, daily_at HH:MM UTC, at an instant), target {artifact_id, operation, body}, optional results_to (where each run is recorded), optional inbox_to (where a failed run is raised as an Inbox item), enabled

daily_at.label: Daily at
daily_at.description: Stored as HH:MM UTC; shown and picked in local time.

at.label: Once, at
at.description: Stored as an ISO 8601 instant; shown and picked in local time.

artifact_id.label: Target
artifact_id.description: The workflow or operator the timer runs.

results_to.label: Record each run in
results_to.description: A collection or workspace; each run is recorded there.

inbox_to.label: Raise a failed run in
inbox_to.description: Your Inbox, or another workspace; a failed run is raised there.

titles.description: The titles of the linked artifacts as they were when picked, keyed by field (target, results_to, inbox_to). Shown, never read.

timer_state.description: Written by Lumen on each run: last_run, last_status, last_error, runs

key.description: The key the timer acts on: api_key_id, resources, armed_at. Never the secret
